title: Reliquary Map Engine
subtitle: Sample Keep (48 × 48) · engine test bench
intro: Kerra, Pip and Lyra stand on the path south of the keep. The portcullis is down; Kerra's torch is lit.
tips: Day or night: use the Sky selector. By day the grounds are bright and the keep dark inside; at night only lights and darkvision show anything.
Kerra carries a torch, Pip has darkvision (greyscale), Lyra has low-light vision (dim light is clear to her). Select one to see exactly what that PC sees.
Get in: the portcullis lets sight through but not feet. The postern door (west) is locked; the GM can open it. Walk the path, the pond's plank bridge (Balance) or the muddy shallows.
The great hall has pillars that block sight, braziers, and a collapsed corner open to the sky (rubble: difficult terrain). The ogre waits inside.
GM view: the map is shaded by light; click a lamp to light it or put it out (the gate torches start unlit). Select a foe the party cannot see to mark it hidden.

Walls to test: stained glass in the chapel (light passes, sight does not), arrow slits in the armoury and tower, a heavy curtain in the tower, a force barrier and fungus glow in the cellar, an illusory wall in the library, a pivoting-bookcase secret door.
Terrain: hearth embers (hazardous), fallen glass (uneven), the pond (Swim), the bluff (Climb), undergrowth. GM: click the cellar's dashed area to flood it.
Sizes: Tiny rats share squares in the cellar, the Large ogre cannot pass 5-ft doors, the Huge giant prowls outside.
